analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($387.84) vs SMA5/20/50 ($380.84/$383.29/$395.46) — above short-term trend, below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($382.97/$364.72) — maintaining strength above long-term trend.
· 52-week position (49.8%) + current price level indicates historical mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.9 → 50.9) — staying in neutral zone, indicating weakening momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (2.1953 → 0.4314) — improving in negative territory, requires confirmation of bottoming.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $383.29) — trading near the middle band, with a band width of 11.14% indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($370.65) — confirmed support based on Pivot S1 ($360.34) and SMA200 ($364.72).
· Swing Resistance ($403.00) — potential for uptrend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day high ($389.90) < 20-day high ($407.52), 5-day low ($369.51) > 20-day low ($356.43), suggesting a narrowing range and potential consolidation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.19x) — normal level compared to 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — holding 'hold' for 4 consecutive days; condition for selling on support break ($370.65), condition for buying on resistance break ($403.00).
